# Input

Single-line text field, optionally wrapped with label, helper and error text.

`KenosUI.Input` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Input />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Input"></x-import>
```

## Props (InputProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"outline" \| "subtle" \| "flushed"` | Default "outline". |
| `size` | `"2xs" \| "xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "2xl"` | Height 28–64px. Default "md" (40px). |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Wraps the input in a field with this label. |
| `helperText` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `errorText` | `React.ReactNode` | Shown instead of helperText when `invalid`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "size">._
